description: Create Slice & Dice: Crop Accelerator — water-based crop growth and lava-based nether wart acceleration for the S&D sprinkler

mods.name: Create Slice & Dice: Crop Accelerator
mods.description: Adds water-based crop growth acceleration and lava-based nether wart acceleration to the Create: Slice & Dice sprinkler.

releases.notes:
Initial release.

- Water sprinklers now accelerate crop growth for wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, cactus, sugar cane, bamboo, and saplings — including crops immune to bonemeal
- Lava sprinklers now accelerate nether wart growth on soul sand
- Growth is applied via random ticks, keeping behaviour consistent with vanilla and mod-added crops
- Server-side only — clients do not need to install this mod

**Requires:** Create, Create: Slice & Dice
